command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: the aarchsci env's python is already first (see recipes/gsw).
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
export ARGO_DIR=/tmp/argo ARGO_PROCS=64
cd /tmp
echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
T0=$(date +%s)
split -n l/64 -d -a 3 pins.sha256 /tmp/pinpart.
ls /tmp/pinpart.* | xargs -P 64 -n 1 sha256sum -c --quiet || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "sha256 in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
{ lscpu | grep -iE 'model name|^cpu\(s\)|thread\(s\) per core|numa node\(s\)'; grep MemTotal /proc/meminfo; df -h /tmp; } > cpu.txt 2>&1; cat cpu.txt
T0=$(date +%s)
# a backstop far inside the TTL: a stuck pool must not ride a 512 GiB box to its cost cap
timeout 40m python3 -u argo.py > gsw-argo.log 2>&1
RC=$?
echo "argo.py exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
cat gsw-argo.log
df -h /tmp
tar -C /tmp -cf /tmp/sample.tar sample
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: the workload failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'GSW ARGO OK' gsw-argo.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo DONE
